basic_details.job_title: Alagappa University Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Animal Health and Management, Alagappa University, Karaikudi has invited applications for a Junior Research Fellow post in a 36-month project, "Magnetic hyperthermia-enhanced nanomaterials for targeting deep-seated metastatic breast cancer". The fellowship is ₹37,000 per month + HRA in the first and second years, and ₹42,000 per month + HRA in the third year (SRF). Applicants need an M.Sc. in Zoology / Life Sciences with at least 60% marks (or equivalent CGPA). They must email their CV to [email protected] by 30 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Email the CV to [email protected] on or before 30 November 2026.
Keep the original certificates in proof of your educational qualifications ready. They must be produced on the day of the interview.
The notice names no subject line, application form or other attachment.
important_instructions: Applications are accepted by email only, at [email protected]. Original educational certificates must be shown on the interview day. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed of the interview by email. The fellowship is subject to satisfactory performance assessment and upgradation.

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies, the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Magnetic hyperthermia-enhanced nanomaterials for targeting deep-seated metastatic breast cancer
₹37,000 per month + HRA (first and second years, JRF); ₹42,000 per month + HRA (third year, SRF)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification is an M.Sc. in Zoology / Life Sciences with a minimum of 60% marks (or equivalent CGPA). The notice prints no experience requirement and no age limit. Candidates with a valid CSIR-UGC NET including Lectureship (Assistant Professorship), or GATE, or any other national-level examination, will be preferred. Desired skills: basic knowledge or practical experience in molecular biology techniques, mammalian cell culture, laboratory animal handling, and nanomaterial synthesis and characterization. Candidates should check the official notification for any discipline-specific eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The project runs for 36 months (3 years). The fellowship is subject to satisfactory performance assessment and upgradation. The place of work is Alagappa University, Science Campus, Karaikudi. The notice also offers an opportunity to register for a Ph.D. in Zoology at Alagappa University, subject to fulfilling the prescribed eligibility criteria and university regulations.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Alagappa University Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Prepare your Curriculum Vitae. Email the CV to [email protected] on or before 30 November 2026. Keep the original certificates in proof of your educational qualifications ready. They must be produced on the day of the interview. The notice names no subject line, application form or other attachment.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be notified by email regarding the date and time of the interview. The notice does not give the interview date or venue, and it does not describe the shortlisting method.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted by email only, at [email protected] . Original educational certificates must be shown on the interview day. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed of the interview by email. The fellowship is subject to satisfactory performance assessment and upgradation.
